name: Tailwind Conic Spinner
css:
.loader { display: inline-block; width: var(--loader-size); height: var(--loader-size); border-radius: 9999px; background: conic-gradient(from 0deg, transparent 0deg, var(--loader-color) 320deg, transparent 360deg); mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 62%, #000 63%); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(farthest-side, transparent 62%, #000 63%); animation: twSpin var(--loader-speed) linear infinite; }
@keyframes twSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
